name: Mercenary Flames of Devotion
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Flames of Devotion (players/paladin/mercenary/flames_of_devotion_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 2 (in brackets): max stacks 12 (24); triggers on any class's primary attack. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Each primary attack hit, from any weapon, adds 1 magical damage to all your skills, up to 12 stacks of 1 s.
